title: Darling in the Franxx: The Charge
alt: A waste of brown cracked ground under a pale dusty sky. At the right a huge black beast like a walking hill, made of square slabs on four legs like towers, with glowing blue lines on its edges, a blue X on its side and a blue light in its chest, lowers its long head. A small white and red flying machine with a long lance charges at its head from the left, with a line of red fire behind it that bends up from a great glass dome on the horizon. A line of blue light from the beast goes by under the machine. Black blocks with blue edges lie on the ground near us.
summary: A painting of Strelizia and a klaxosaur from Darling in the Franxx in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the world of Darling in the Franxx, the anime by Trigger and A-1 Pictures. People live in great domed cities that move, the Plantations. Beasts that are called klaxosaurs come up out of the earth, and children fight them in machines that are called Franxx.
The white and red machine is Strelizia, the Franxx of Zero Two and Hiro. It is far off and small. No one is in the picture. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
